newsitem.title: USA: USX accepts tendered 6.5 pct cumulative preferred.
newsitem.headline: USX accepts tendered 6.5 pct cumulative preferred.

text.p: USX Corp said Friday it accepted the 3.9 million 6.50 percent cumulative convertible preferred shares tendered in response to the company's offer to exchange the preferred for 6.75 percent convertible preferred securities of USX Capital Trust I, a Delaware statuory business unit.
The offer expired at midnight on May 15, the company noted.
It said about 3.0 million shares of the 6.5 preferred stock will remain outstanding and will continue to be listed and traded on the New York Stock Exchange.
USX common is traded in the form of securities representing the results of its three operating groups -- USX-U.S. Steel, USX-Marathon and USX-Delhi. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
